競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Wabashが10-Kで、トレーラーを納める大口顧客の混載(LTL)輸送会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wabash lists it among large LTL carrier customers for its trailers

source.label: Wabash 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ▪ Less-Than-Truckload Carriers: Saia, Inc.; FedEx Freight, Inc; Old Dominion Freight Lines, Inc.; and R&L Carriers, Inc.

relations.text: 破綻したYellowから、破産手続きで17のターミナルを買い取り、11拠点の賃借権を得た(2024年1月)
relations.text_en: Bought 17 terminals and took over leases on 11 more from bankrupt Yellow (January 2024)

source.label: Saia 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In January 2024, we acquired 17 freight terminals and leases to operate an additional 11 freight terminals pursuant to a sale by Yellow Corporation

relations.text: FedExが10-Kで、FedEx Freightの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: FedEx names it a primary competitor of FedEx Freight

source.label: FedEx 10-K(2025年5月期)
source.quote: FedEx Freight's primary competitors are XPO, Inc., Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc., ABF Freight (an ArcBest company), SAIA, Inc., and TFI International Inc.

relations.text: XPOが10-Kで、北米の混載輸送の競合として名指し
relations.text_en: XPO names it a North American LTL competitor

source.label: XPO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors in North America include local, regional and national LTL carriers that offer the same services we provide, such as Old Dominion Freight Line and Saia.

relations.text: ArcBestが10-Kで、最も直接に競合する混載輸送会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: ArcBest names it among the LTL carriers it competes with most directly

source.label: ArcBest 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The segment competes most directly with nonunion and union LTL carriers, including FedEx Freight Corporation, the LTL reporting segment of FedEx Corporation; the LTL segment of Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc.; Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc.; Saia, Inc.; the U.S. LTL operating segment of TFI International Inc.; and the North American LTL segment of XPO, Inc.

companies.name: フレイト・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Freight Technologiesが20-Fで、メキシコの混載輸送の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Freight Technologies names it a Mexican LTL competitor

source.label: Freight Technologies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: in our Fr8Now business we compete principally with Mexican LTL specialists including Saia, Inc., Penske Logistics, TIBA Group and Pak2Go
